summary: Raise project-side architecture maintainability, repeatable verification, evidence governance and extension handoff quality without changing runtime gameplay or protocol semantics.

authoritative_state: This batch does not move ownership of Base, Head, Projectile or persistence state.
Existing targeting and combat services remain server-thread services with explicit world-query adapters.

schema.owner: No runtime persistence schema is introduced by this batch.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: The batch adds only project-side audits and CI; existing common/server code must continue to load without client-only classes.

budgets.scope: The existing fixed 100/100 pressure evidence and real old-save evidence consumed by the maturity audit.
budgets.measurement: The audit must observe a passing pressure comparison within the existing budget and a passing old-save round-trip without replacing or weakening either threshold.

hot_paths: TurretBaseBlockEntity server tick and attachment views
TurretHeadBlockEntity target selection and combat orchestration
performance.measurement_environment: Reuse the architecture-optimization-20260807 fixed Windows/Java 21/NeoForge 21.1.234 evidence; this batch adds no default runtime instrumentation.

mods.fallback: The project remains pinned to the existing NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: Service direction, client isolation, state ownership and cache/lifecycle boundaries are mechanically auditable.
criteria.observation: The project-side maturity audit passes and the existing static/dedicated-server gates remain green.

criteria.statement: A clean CI entry point reproduces the project documentation, contract, compile, resource, behavior and dedicated-server quality line without modifying the external toolkit.
criteria.observation: The workflow is reviewed, local Major and server gates pass, and the maturity audit confirms the workflow commands and .agents immutability.

criteria.statement: Pressure and old-save evidence remain reproducible and are not replaced by unsupported claims about JFR or environment noise.
criteria.observation: The maturity audit consumes the retained pressure comparison and old-save report; the pressure budget remains unchanged and passing.

criteria.statement: A new turret contributor has a documented definition-driven path that does not require Base/Head concrete branches.
criteria.observation: The extension guide and Potato path audit agree, and the existing GameTest/pressure path remains available.

criteria.statement: This batch does not change gameplay, registry identity, persistence schema, network payload schema or default runtime diagnostic cost.
criteria.observation: The batch is limited to project-side audit/docs/CI files; L0/L1/L2/L2.5/L3/L4 and retained old-save evidence remain green.

covers: Project-side architecture boundaries, evidence integrity, CI presence and .agents immutability.
tests.expected: maturity-audit.json is generated and all critical checks pass.

covers: Every maturity contract test_id resolves to a real script or gate command.
tests.expected: All declared maturity test executors resolve; executor presence remains distinct from execution pass/fail.

covers: The extension guide and execution documents remain discoverable and free of broken references.
tests.expected: Documentation index and metadata gates pass.

covers: The project documentation trust metadata remains valid for the pinned Minecraft and NeoForge versions.
L0 contract, L1 compile, L2 static, DataGen, L2.5 assets, L4 GameTest and traceability remain green.
tests.expected: The Major pipeline passes without runtime source changes from this batch.

covers: Common/server client isolation and dedicated-server startup remain valid.
tests.expected: Dedicated server reaches completion without client classloading or runtime errors.

covers: Retained fixed pressure comparison and real old-save evidence remain within the original budget.
tests.expected: pressure-comparison.json is pass=true and old-save-input.json is status=pass; thresholds are unchanged.

covers: Definition-driven Potato extension path remains free of Base/Head-specific branches.

steps: Run one client session after all automation is complete.
Check GUI energy/configuration, Jade, Shift tooltip, Beam and projectile visuals.
Change world, disconnect to menu, reconnect, run F3+T, then exit normally.
manual_checks.expected: Existing client behavior remains unchanged and client caches do not leak across world or connection boundaries.

non_goals: Changing gameplay balance, registry identities, config defaults, save keys or Payload schemas.
Splitting TurretBaseBlockEntity or TurretProjectileEntity without new profiler evidence.
Adding default per-tick runtime diagnostics or network traffic.
Modifying, formatting or iterating the external .agents toolkit.
Replacing the final manual client check with server-only evidence.
